recap.text: Katia is a former art teacher and a Doppelgänger Monster Truck Driver who can reshape her mass. She uses a pencil-like detonator for Carl to ensure mutually assured destruction against a lich. After saving NPCs during a quest, Katia uses Rush to go through a wall. She joins the Royal Court of Princess Donut and increases from level nine to twenty-one.

Katia uses a momentum bonus to lead the party through doors and carries a shape-shifting shield. She emulates Hekla and Carl, growing a third eye and turning herself into a metal cowcatcher for a subway car. After killing Hekla, Katia gains a wrestling belt and a riot shield. She identifies the map as double-sided and uses a Bolt of Ophiotaurus.

Katia uses a potion to bring her Catcher skill to eleven and an earth hobby potion to build the Chariot. She kills Ghazi for notes on the Gate and uses a diving bell to enter the Akula. After fighting a sea monster with a buzzsaw, she receives a gold boss box with an adjustable backpack. Katia decides to separate from Carl to find the former daughters before Eva.

Katia takes a HAZMAT endorsement and reaches level fifty-two, gaining Steely Skin. She maps a hundred thousand square kilometres for Carl and leaves the party after helping purchase spaces for Mordecai and Mistress Tiatha. Katia kills Eva and takes the Crown of the Sepsis Whore, while secretly using addictive blitz sticks to see visions of her daughter, Annie.

Katia uses a speed boon in Iceland. She gives Carl Flee cards after Louis kills two hundred Lads. To remove the Crown of the Sepsis Whore, Katia takes the Celestial Attendant boon and Carl repairs a blue shrine of Yemaya. Katia and Carl kill Astrid in a kitchen using a card deck and a spike. Katia travels to Da Nang and drives a Bolt of Ophiotaurus into the eye of Ysalte.

Katia carries Tran through Larracos to a saferoom and traps a screaming Samantha in a corner. She uses a potion of Glory Bound and Tough Love to enter a dream where she and Carl hold hands. Katia tattoos a dragon chain on Carl using Li Na's blood. She tricks guards with stuffed pyxies and eats the Orchid of Eileithyia's Grace to be made pregnant and human, losing an arm, a leg, and an ear to leave the dungeon.

beats.headline: Ten levels behind and nobody's problem
beats.text: I came in with a friend. We fell in with Hekla and Brynhild's Daughters, who carried the two of us through a neighbourhood boss and a borough boss, and I know exactly how much of that was us. Class selection split us up, and she did not wait. Now Hekla is asking Carl and Donut to take me. The system has just upgraded my displayed race from "What the f-word?" to "Human", so things are looking up.
beats.gist: Katia Grim enters with a friend and joins Hekla and Brynhild's Daughters.

beats.headline: Doppelgänger, Monster Truck Driver
beats.text: Bannon, my guide, talked me into it: a momentum-based constitution tank who can reshape her own mass, body and equipped gear together, into any form of the same weight. I sculpted my face using my reflection in a health potion bottle. Carl says it looks like a Juan Gris. He is being kind, and I would know.
beats.gist: Katia Grim is a momentum-based constitution tank who reshapes her mass and gear into any form.

beats.headline: Fuel tank, battering ram, stairwell finder
beats.text: Strength eleven. Intelligence eight, Charisma eight. Dexterity thirty. Constitution fifty-one: fifteen from a ring out of a loot box at the start, more from buffs, more from the class. Second Fuel Tank absorbs damage and reflects some back, once a fight, at random. Rush uses my body as a battering ram, once a thirty-hour day. Pathfinder finds stairwells. I am immune to wind spells. My Earth Hobby Potion made me a gear head, though I have never fixed an engine. I was an art teacher. What is the saying? Those who can't do, teach.
beats.gist: Katia Grim is an art teacher with high constitution and abilities to reflect damage and find stairwells.

beats.headline: Holding the boom switch
beats.text: My face is better now. Carl calls me out of the crowd and puts a pencil-like detonator in my hand, and I back away from it; the description says it might click on its own. Keep it in your inventory, he says. If they die, or if he says so, press the button. They need someone outside the lich's influence holding it. Mutually assured destruction, then. Hekla warned me that he was crazy. Then he tells the crowd they are all still in the blast zone, and I back up with the rest of them.
beats.gist: Carl gives Katia Grim a pencil-like detonator to press if he dies or says so.

beats.headline: She spends a death sentence saving NPCs
beats.text: The Fools Who Broke the Glass quest is close to unsurvivable, and it triggers before I have earned my place. I spend the time getting NPCs out. I tell Carl and Donut to save themselves. I mean it.
beats.gist: Katia Grim spends a death sentence saving NPCs during the Fools Who Broke the Glass quest.

beats.headline: Through the wall
beats.text: The fourth pulse fires the first things in everyone's hotlist, and for me that is Rush. I glow, clip Carl on the way past, and go straight through the wall of the building with the stairwell in it. That really hurt. At the bottom of the stairs Carl has me take out the detonator. It has a ten-second delay; press it at about fifteen. Won't that make the bomb go off faster? By a couple of seconds, he says, and it probably died in the first burst anyway, but if it works we all share the experience. I press it at twenty.
beats.gist: Katia Grim glows, clips Carl, and goes through a wall to reach a detonator.

beats.headline: This is the real me
beats.text: We come through the door into a green room that seems to be on a boat. Donut says I am getting really good at the sculpting. I touch my face. This is the real me: short black hair, the face I came in with. On Odette's couch I am brought out as the newest member of the Royal Court of Princess Donut, and I answer her questions one word at a time. Then she puts our levels up over our heads. I have gone from nine to twenty-one.
beats.gist: Katia Grim enters a green boat room and joins the Royal Court of Princess Donut.

beats.headline: First through every door
beats.text: Something on this floor has doubled my constitution to 102. It is a momentum bonus, though we are standing still, and Carl says it may be patched out tonight. So I go through each door first, because my constitution is four times his. I suppose that is my job. The first time, Mongo leaps in with me and I land on my face, and my axe skitters ten feet ahead. It is a good weapon. My strength is not high enough for it.
beats.gist: Katia Grim goes through every door first because her constitution is 102.

beats.headline: A shield that looks like my sleeve
beats.text: My box gives me an arm bracer that becomes a shield. When I activate it, it takes on the look of whatever is around it, so it is a buckler of blue polyester, but it rings like metal when I knock on it. Mordecai says it carries Shatter and I should use it with Rush. Donut says I can be the liquid metal Terminator. I never saw that film. I don't like violence. She says I am in the wrong job, honey. I have promised my coupons to Hekla, and Mordecai has already worked that out.
beats.gist: Katia Grim gets an arm bracer that becomes a shield.

beats.headline: Catching the club from behind
beats.text: On the platform we kill whatever stands in the train's doorways, and nothing on board can reach us. Hekla's party has been doing it all morning; she thinks it's a bug. Carl thinks it is a time trap. So we board, and I use the shape I have been practising: shorter, squat, forearms swollen. When a bonker swings at Carl, I catch the club from behind and add to its swing, and he stumbles into Carl's fist. A spike caught me, but it mostly scraped the metal part of my arm. Mostly.
beats.gist: Katia Grim catches a bonker's club and pushes it into Carl's fist.

beats.headline: Every station, relayed
beats.text: Vernon says the yellow line meets Indigo at 89, where the Daughters were, but they are on the Winter Sky line now. So when Carl and Donut go to the porter car, they leave me with him. He knows every station: its monsters, which ones are transit stations, which lines meet at each. I pass it all to Mordecai, who complains about being our secretary and writes it down. When the ants come, the explosion throws me off my feet. The train is stopped, so my momentum bonus is gone, and my health drops further than Carl expects.
beats.gist: Vernon tells Katia Grim about the yellow and Winter Sky lines before an explosion drops her health.

beats.headline: A purple mohawk
beats.text: Donut tells me I need a mohawk and a catchphrase, because Zev thinks I need to be more vibrant. I have almost ten billion followers, and it was almost nothing before I joined them. She has over 700 trillion. Rookie numbers, she says. So while Carl gathers up the robot scrap, I let her dress me: a black bodysuit, knee-high boots I did not shape well, a purple mohawk. Carl says to just be myself. Donut says that is terrible advice for a doppelganger. I don't know what being myself means anyway. I never really did.
beats.gist: Donut and Katia Grim dress Katia in a black bodysuit, poorly shaped knee-high boots, and a purple mohawk.

beats.headline: Hekla at sixty-five percent
beats.text: I'm on the couch wearing Hekla when they come back, and it holds until Carl reads the name over my head. The ability is called Walk in Their Shoes, and it only switches on at a ninety percent match. This Hekla is sixty-five. I spent both upgrade coupons on the Makeup Table: at level three I can put any face I've met on the glass, and save three designs. Carl tries hard not to sound horrified. Then they pile the dead assassin's armor at my feet, and I see the skull over Donut's head.
beats.gist: Katia Grim wears Hekla at sixty-five percent while Carl reads the name over her head.

beats.headline: Fingers that do not come back
beats.text: Gore-Gore chopped my fingers off when I was protecting Carl. Carl thought it was only armor. When I healed, my fingers didn't come back. It's stupid. I can build fingers from other parts of me. I'm like clay; all I lost was a bit of flesh, and I moved the ring from the severed finger onto the new ones. But part of me is gone. I'm losing myself. Carl taps my forehead and tells me the real Katia is still in there, and not to let them break me. I say okay.
beats.gist: Gore-Gore chops off Katia Grim's fingers while she protects Carl.

beats.headline: Reading the Tangle
beats.text: My sponsor is a princess too, it says. Princess Formidable of the Skull Empire. I haven't received anything from her. Over the soup I fill Mordecai's map in with the ochre line and what the daughters have sent, and I find us a route: change lines, take the Dismemberment Limited, change for the Nightmare Express two stations down on the Mauve line, and ride it to 436, one past the end. Hours instead of days. Carl doesn't understand a word but believes me. Try the Tokyo subway knowing only Icelandic, German, Russian and English.
beats.gist: Katia Grim finds a route using the Dismemberment Limited and the Nightmare Express to reach 436.

beats.headline: A ton and a quarter
beats.text: The system calls it the Ugly Ass Backpack With a Completely Useless Design that Only an Idiot Would Wear. Carl loads it with metal poles and balls while it sits on a stand, I make myself into a shelf on legs, and when the stand falls away the pack equips and becomes me. A ton and a quarter, give or take. I tip over like a turtle, then reshape: eleven feet tall, with a strength bonus for carrying the mass. When the daughters hear about this, they're going to flip out. If only Fannar could see me.
beats.gist: Katia Grim equips a ton and a quarter of metal poles and balls in a backpack.

beats.headline: Traveling spikes
beats.text: Babababoons in the transit station, second stage of the DTs, crawling all over the Nightmare. I have one in a bear hug and he's hitting me really hard. Then my body jerks to the side and takes his top half with it. I think I've figured out how to move the metal around inside me. It's slow, but it hurt him more than it hurt me. I think I can make traveling spikes, so anything using its hands impales itself on me. When I do it really fast, it feels like breaking my own bones.
beats.gist: Katia Grim moves metal inside her body to create traveling spikes that impale attackers.

beats.headline: A third eye, pointed backwards
beats.text: The description says at least two of my eyes have to be flesh, which means I can have more. More than two makes me want to vomit, so I am training a third, pointed behind me, a minute or two at a time before the headache. It makes me feel less human. It is also how I saw Donut push a slip of paper under the track while Carl was gone. I grew an arm along the rail and took it. It has his name on it. Hekla thinks it was a setup to test me. I give it to Carl.
beats.gist: Katia Grim trains a backward-pointing third eye and takes a paper from Donut with an arm.

beats.headline: They came back for me
beats.text: Hekla wants me on the front of a subway car as a plough, and Carl is horrified, and he does not know it was my idea. I widened my backpack at his engineering table while he was away, so I carry more metal now, with a layer of rubber between the metal and the flesh to take the impacts. I tell him it is what I am for. I call him a backseat dungeon driver. He does not understand, and I tell him so: she brought the entire team to pick me up. Nobody has ever done that for me.
beats.gist: Katia Grim wants to be a plough on a subway car for Hekla.

beats.headline: Katia as the cowcatcher
beats.text: I am the cowcatcher: a scoop and a comb, spikes at chest height, anchored through the windows like a toggle bolt, rubber on the side near the third rail. The first mobs are a bee sting, and experience. Whatever lands in the scoop goes into my inventory, liquids too, under a new tab called Gross shit. Near 72 I get a fan box for the most new followers in thirty hours. Then something shocks me unconscious. In the main horde my health keeps falling and nobody can say why. When I come to, I ask Carl where I am, and why Eva is not answering me.
beats.gist: Katia Grim acts as a cowcatcher with a scoop, a comb, and spikes at chest height.

beats.headline: Rush, a few inches wide
beats.text: I cannot remember the fight. Everything hurts, Hekla is smoking against the wall, and Donut says Hekla tried to kill me. I think it was an accident. Then Eva tells me they only meant to make Carl's temper flare, and mocks me in my own voice: Fannar leaving me for a student, the adoption they would not give me. She says this is why she left me behind on the third floor. I use Rush, which I hate, and aim it at Eva. It goes a few inches wide. When I fall back from the wall, there is a golden skull over my head.
beats.gist: Katia Grim uses Rush against Eva, but it goes a few inches wide.

beats.headline: Nowhere to sit down
beats.text: It has to be me who loots her, because I killed her, so I get the Vermillion key. Carl drags half of Hekla into the cab; the other half stays beyond the door. Eva went out of the window. She is still in my chat. I did not mean to kill Hekla. I am not even a little okay, and there is nowhere in this cab to sit down and have a breakdown, and all three of us laugh until we stop. When Carl says it is too bad about the crossbow, I let it form in my hands.
beats.gist: Katia Grim loots her own kill for the Vermillion key and forms a crossbow.

beats.headline: Ten boxes and a belt
beats.text: Ten boxes. The first puts a dagger tattoo on my neck, and Donut says we can go dancing. The gold Savage box has no coupons in it, only a Find Crawler skill potion, level three, and I drink it at once. The bounty box is five hundred thousand gold. Being the first to collect a bounty earns an achievement and nothing else. A Platinum Slam Master box holds a wrestling belt: five percent strength, five percent constitution, and Avalanche, which hits whatever my moving body strikes with twice the mass. The platinum fan box is still being voted on.
beats.gist: Katia Grim opens ten boxes, including a Platinum Slam Master box with a wrestling belt.

beats.headline: Ninety-eight percent gnoll
beats.text: The key plates want gnoll hands, so I try to become a gnoll. I get to ninety-eight percent, and the last time I come out the system designates me a gnoll, and the plates still refuse me. So I stay in the personal space while they do what has to be done to Growler Gary. I understand why. I don't want to be part of it. What I can do is take an engine apart: my Gear Head knowledge base knows engines, and I am certain we can put this one back together on something else.
beats.gist: Katia Grim becomes ninety-eight percent gnoll to trigger key plates, but the plates refuse her.

beats.headline: The sentinel gun against a stage three
beats.text: I roll back into the sentinel gun: three legs, the shield, Hekla's crossbow locked in behind it, and a firing slit I open and close like a mouth. Two bolts a second, slower than when she owned it, and the fire and the lightning went with the rest of her gear. The Razor Fox barely notices. I think the body is a kind of living armour; the tentacles take real damage, but they are hard to hit, and my crossbow skill is still four. Eva's saber is no use to me on its own. It is only magic as a pair, which means she has lost hers too.
beats.gist: Katia Grim rolls into a sentinel gun to fire bolts at a Razor Fox.

beats.headline: The riot shield and the baton
beats.text: My fan box is a riot shield with "Get Back" across the front, and a telescoping police baton. I cannot tell if people are trolling me; they know I hate using Rush. The shield upgrades it to Crowd Blast: everything in a wide cone in front of me takes part of the hit, and I can use it every five minutes instead of once a day. The baton casts knockback when I swing it at ten or more. The shield will not share my arm with the Auto Buckler of the Peach Pit, so I give the buckler to Carl. He needs a shield anyway.
beats.gist: Katia Grim gets a riot shield and a telescoping police baton from her fan box.

beats.headline: One bolt from the youngest sister
beats.text: My sponsor is Princess Formidable, youngest sister of the Maestro, who is dead, and of Crown Prince Stalwart, who we think is walking around inside Grull. We know nothing about her beyond the fact that she exists, so there is no predicting what she sends. The silver box holds a single crossbow bolt. The Bolt of Ophiotaurus, one of a hundred. An ordinary bolt, unless it goes into a deity's eye; then the god's invulnerability pauses for fifteen seconds. Carl says he is starting to think the sister is not a huge fan of her big brother.
beats.gist: Princess Formidable sends a silver box containing the Bolt of Ophiotaurus to Katia Grim.

beats.headline: Two tracks on every noodle
beats.text: It has bothered me for days: we are still missing half the system, and the logo only works from above. Mordecai says they have flipped floors upside down several times; it is easy and saves space. So I fold the map in half, tear it a little, and it works. Each line is a noodle with track on the outside, and another track upside down on the opposite side of the same noodle. Dig under station 59 on the zomp line and you reach station 59 on some other line, with an empty chamber between. The mimics are so big because each fills two stations. It feels like a trap to me.
beats.gist: Katia Grim folds and tears a map to find two tracks on every noodle.

beats.headline: Crowd Blast down a hallway
beats.text: I hate that ability. I turn the riot shield ninety degrees and Crowd Blast into a hallway crammed with Krakaren and ghouls, and they go back like bowling pins. Acid in the air; it burns. I come out at a T junction, stairs going down on both sides, swing the baton one way and fire the crossbow the other. There are about fifty of them at the bottom of each stair, and Carl throws a boom jug down both. Donut jumps us back to the main room. But it works well.
beats.gist: Katia Grim Crowd Blasts Krakaren and ghouls down a hallway and Carl throws boom jugs.

beats.headline: Carl, on a derailed train
beats.text: Carl is inside the trainyard walls and cannot get back out. So I tell him to shut up and listen: run back toward where the portal brought him in. Elle bounces icicles off Grull's head to turn him. On a derailed train by the gate I make myself into Carl, cloak and heart-covered boxers and all, and stand there with both hands up, flipping off the god. Then I jump down and disappear. He screams and comes after me.
beats.gist: Katia Grim tells Carl to run toward the portal and mimics Carl to lure Grull.

beats.headline: Next time I will be you
beats.text: In the production trailer my body stops answering; I arrive as my plain self with the heavy backpack straining on my shoulders, and Loita makes me put it away. On air, Odette asks whether I have done Carl before, since I did him so well. This time I recover on my own: I am getting better at emulating people, and next time maybe I will pretend to be her. Afterwards she says I was much better than last time. I still need to learn to relax.
beats.gist: Katia Grim arrives as her plain self with a heavy backpack and emulates Carl.

beats.headline: A building under our feet
beats.text: My pathfinder skill is acting oddly: behind us there is nothing but the mountain wall. But the wall looks carved, not grown, and I say so. I think there is a building under our feet. At a cave mouth a forcefield keeps us out until our own quadrant's castle is liberated. Carl rolls a bomb through and sets off a trap somewhere below. I throw a lit torch after it, and it shows a long, sloping hallway of carved bricks. An underground tomb, I think. Like Indiana Jones.
beats.gist: Katia Grim finds a carved wall and a building under her feet.

beats.headline: Catcher at eleven, Eva on chat
beats.text: My gold Survivor's box holds a skill potion I have to drink on the spot, and it takes Catcher, the skill I have been training relentlessly, to eleven. The rest is gold, water-breathing scrolls and antidote potions, which Mordecai reads as a warning about poison. I asked the former Daughters whether any of them are in this bubble. Nobody answered. Eva is still alive. She is still on my chat. My find crawler shows eight others nearby, all in their low twenties, and I don't know any of them.
beats.gist: Katia Grim drinks a skill potion from a gold Survivor's box to take Catcher to eleven.

beats.headline: Never going to fly
beats.text: In the Spit and Swallow two drunk crawlers have a changeling on a lap, describing famous women for her to become. She looks me up and down, spits on the floor, and moves to the other side of the room. Mordecai warned me shapeshifters sometimes don't like each other. Donut says she's jealous. Maybe. Changelings gain some of the abilities of whatever they become. I weigh more than most flying creatures my size, even with no mass added; I would need something like a dragon, and there isn't time. I'm never going to be able to fly, not like them.
beats.gist: Katia Grim is a changeling who gains abilities of what she becomes but cannot fly.

beats.headline: Knowing it without knowing it
beats.text: Carl and I build the Chariot side by side at the engineering table, and every time I wonder how a track mechanism goes together, the answer is simply there. That is the earth hobby potion. I know how engines work, but I don't know it, know it; it is as if it is downloaded on demand. If people out there can buy expertise like this, how is there so much cruelty? Carl thinks it must be expensive, like plastic surgery. I still can't stop thinking about it. He suggests calling me Katia Prime. I do not find it as amusing as he does.
beats.gist: Carl and Katia Grim build the Chariot using an earth hobby potion that downloads engine expertise.

beats.headline: A pipe behind the town hall
beats.text: I am a pipe on the building behind the town hall, with a view of the back door. A dromedarian named Henrik comes out, level 30, and shows the guards an ID first. Through the open door I count at least twelve guards, two everywhere, so my plan to copy someone and walk in is dead. I keep watch instead. Three guards step out for a smoke and I tell Carl to go now. Then a waster guard stops two ordinary camels at the door, kills them both, and drags them inside. They stay camels when they die.
beats.gist: Katia Grim watches a town hall door and tells Carl to go.

beats.headline: Sneak in, sneak out. Good job
beats.text: I stroll up in human form with a drink with a little umbrella in it. The plan was to sneak in, find out what was hidden, and sneak out again undetected. Good job. The frog con won't last; this world is too small, and the only ones who saw any frogs are the new people. Then my second sponsor arrives: the Squim Conglomerate, which sponsors about five hundred other crawlers. Loita books me alone on a one-on-one interview show called Dungeon Sidekicks. I can't wait.
beats.gist: Katia Grim enters in human form with a drink and a little umbrella.

beats.headline: I hope it was a lie
beats.text: I spent the storm at the club with Morris and Bobby, drawing them a general map of the necropolis and a detailed path to a town halfway down. They're total trainwrecks. If something happens to Bobby, the whole team is dead; he's the only one who detects traps, he has already missed a few, and they send others ahead of him who die in front of him. They kept asking when we would storm our castle, so they can wait for our help. I told them we don't expect to finish the air quadrant until time is almost up. At least I hope it was a lie.
beats.gist: Katia Grim draws a map for Morris and Bobby, who wait for help to storm their castle.

beats.headline: A counterweight in one hand
beats.text: Carl makes me turn the Chariot toward a level 55 bird towing a row of buzzsaws, so I grow a second face on the back of my head to ask if he's crazy. He fires, and I turn too sharply, and the Chariot starts to tip. I hold my arm out on the other side and put mass into my hand until we come level, then drop it. We didn't need to drive toward it; the first stage had range enough. He says he didn't want to damage the prize, and I know he means the saw.
beats.gist: Carl makes Katia turn the Chariot toward a bird towing buzzsaws, and she grows a second face.

beats.headline: Chair, gnome and Henrik at once
beats.text: I am the back seat of the Chariot, the body under Wynne's head, and Henrik in the cart behind, joined to the rest by an arm draped over the seat. My Henrik voice is not very good. When Firas cuts his throat, I pull that mass back in, and the robe falls onto the changeling corpse already hidden in the cart. Leon, leaning right against me, lays his hand on the gnome's head, and his spell finds no changeling. Then the head I am wearing times out and turns to dust, and I grow a new one before anyone looks. Carl pours Mountain Dew down my throat. Who can drink this bile?
beats.gist: Katia Grim mimics a chair, a body under Wynne's head, and Henrik.

beats.headline: Ten bolts from Princess Formidable
beats.text: An emergency silver benefactor box, from Princess Formidable, and Mordecai says to open it now. Ten bolts of Petrify Rock Class. I put one into the head of the thing wearing Chris while it stands over Carl with something round in its hand. Petrified, sixty seconds, and every bolt resets the timer. I wonder why they would send bolts that only petrify instead of kill. Mordecai says they cost more than regular ones. I keep shooting while the others argue. When there is nothing left to argue, I tell Carl he does not have a skull yet, and I do. Let me do it.
beats.gist: Katia Grim uses Petrify Rock Class bolts from Princess Formidable to petrify a creature wearing Chris.

beats.headline: Did you ever want children
beats.text: We stand looking up at the house wedged against the top of the bubble, and I ask Carl whether he ever wanted children. He says no; he would not be a good dad. I tell him I could not have children, when I was human. I was going to adopt. You can do that in Iceland when you are single. I was pre-approved. I was on the list. Something happened, and I was disqualified. It is not important. I tell him I am glad now, because Maggie is what losing everything does to a mother. And I am happy to sit this one out.
beats.gist: Katia Grim asks Carl if he wanted children; she says she was pre-approved for adoption in Iceland.

beats.headline: Five days on my own
beats.text: Carl and Donut vanished from chat, Mordecai disappeared, and none of them showed as dead. Once I learned we would not know for days, I took matters into my own hands. The house would not fly to the land quadrant at first. It was the stairwell in the master bedroom; we almost died working that out, and the fix is what Louis did to his mother's minivan. Without the controller Carl left with Louis, we could not have flown it at all. Five days of scorpion men and arguing with Gwen. Level 41. Zev says she is our temporary PR agent.
beats.gist: Katia Grim is a level 41 temporary PR agent who fought scorpion men for five days.

beats.headline: Holding out for the hard way
beats.text: There are two ways into the sandcastle. Gwen's team found a drainage wheel against the tomb wall: turn it and the water inside blasts out through the drain the castle is built around, and the castle goes like sand under a hose. It also turns the mage, and the winding box, to mud. The hard way is to clip the towers' cables to the door and let the storm's lightning open a glass hallway, once per storm, for a few of us. Zev was unusually insistent that we wait for Carl and Donut, so I made Gwen wait almost a day. Honestly, I would rather do it her way too.
beats.gist: Katia Grim describes two ways into the sandcastle, including a drainage wheel and lightning cables.

beats.headline: Under the door
beats.text: Carl has his eye to the peephole and Donut is talking about Juice Box when I see the sand. It is oozing through the bottom of the door and moving its way up the wood. I pull him back and shout for his shell. The spell pushes the ooze back and blasts the door to pieces. Then Carl knocks the mage out, and I catch him before he lands, throw him over my shoulder and carry him up the stairs while the floor follows us.
beats.gist: Katia Grim blasts sand through a door and carries an unconscious Carl up the stairs.

beats.headline: She kills Ghazi and takes his notes
beats.text: The sand ooze is dead and the walls are coming in. I get out with Ghazi. Then I kill him, for the notes that explain how the Gate works. Carl and Donut are still buried when I do it. I know how that sounds.
beats.gist: Katia kills Ghazi for notes on the Gate while Carl and Donut are buried.

beats.headline: She turns the watches into a map
beats.text: The linked watches read as a reverse compass: a time, an altitude, an exact position relative to anywhere else. Which means the Gate could open onto the city of Larracos, on the ninth floor, and I am mapping ground nobody has stood on.
beats.gist: Katia Grim turns linked watches into a map of the city of Larracos on the ninth floor.

beats.headline: She planned it from inside the doll
beats.text: I think I see it. When she first escaped, half of her went into the love doll, the closest thing to her real form she could find. So she was the one who talked Ghazi into coming here, and let him think he was calling the god of lust. When he opened the way, her second half came out with the sand ooze. Then something went wrong, the doll was turned to glass with everything else, and she had to use the ooze to keep him here. The scholars thought she had gone into Quetzalcoatlus. Nobody knew there were two halves.
beats.gist: Katia Grim split herself into two halves to trick Ghazi and use sand ooze.

beats.headline: The diving bell
beats.text: I make a diving bell I have never made before, on the spot, hanging off the corner of the house: more an elevator than a bell, three poles for Carl, Tran and Vadim to hold, a ring of dense metal at the bottom so I do not flip. We drop at about five meters a second. Five hundred meters down I open like a flower on the hull of the Akula, spread myself over it as camouflage and stay outside to watch while they go in. Something swims by underneath. It is bigger than the submarine.
beats.gist: Katia Grim makes a diving bell that drops Carl, Tran, and Vadim onto the Akula.

beats.headline: Too late to surface
beats.text: Carl tells me to blow my ballast and get to the surface. It is already too late; the big thing is reaching for the sub. So instead of going up I go in, through the torn-open top and down the corridors toward them, and wait in the airlock while it drains, which takes almost a full minute. Carl swears at me over chat. I would not have gotten away. Then I bring Tran and Vadim through, and the three of us stand at the bridge window and watch the second monster come.
beats.gist: Katia Grim enters a monster through a torn-open top to rescue Tran and Vadim.

beats.headline: Leatherface, underwater
beats.text: Carl calls Leatherface. The move is made for the flying house, and I do not have the mass for it, so I just hold on: braces around Carl and Tran, the steam rocket wrapped in my flesh, and the twenty-five-foot buzzsaw out of my inventory, running. We spin the wrong way, out of her mouth, then back through her snout, and the saw cuts through her like a hot knife. It is her brain we hit. One of her tentacles slams us into the sea floor, the saw buries itself, and I let go.
beats.gist: Katia Grim uses a twenty-five-foot buzzsaw to cut through a creature's brain.

beats.headline: A backpack of my own
beats.text: Three levels for me too, to 44. The gold boss box gives me a backpack: much the same as the one Carl designed for my mass, but adjustable, so I can carry even more, and it will not break. It gives me a stability enhancement while I wear it and has retractable stilts, so I can add mass far more quickly. It is good. Carl got all the best things this time. He says we should have tried to swim out. Donut says they never gave us a choice.
beats.gist: Katia Grim reaches level 44 and gets an adjustable backpack with retractable stilts from a gold boss box.

beats.headline: The paper on the stall door
beats.text: The toilet stall in the personal space is the one place we can trade messages unseen: a magical author's kit, the paper clipped inside the door, and anything I write appears in Carl's scratch pad. I took it down when the refugees came and put it back to send him my latest calculation. Then Louis ate the monkey soup and got to the stall before I could stop him. I tell Carl. He wipes the page and starts a warning, and the ink runs out halfway through it.
beats.gist: Katia Grim uses a magical author's kit to trade messages with Carl via a toilet stall.

beats.headline: Separate, next floor
beats.text: I tell Carl and Donut we need to separate next floor. It is because of Eva. She is gathering the former daughters back to her. Silfa and her two daughters formed a party with her, and they are dead. The next floor is open. I have to gather the ones who are left before Eva does, and deal with her if I must. I will not leave the party yet. Louis and Firas, Gwen's team, Bautista and some friends, and Florin are coming with me. Carl gives me the Left Fang of the Green Sultan, to return to its owner.
beats.gist: Katia Grim tells Carl and Donut they must separate next floor to gather former daughters before Eva.

beats.headline: Anchored under the gate
beats.text: The gate opens in the water quadrant, and the timed charges Carl made are sucked straight in. I dropped the chum bomb nearby just before, and it worked really well: the sharks are in their feeding frenzy and slurping in after the charges, with some of the pain amplifier jellies. I am anchored to the temple wall against the current. Then out by the subterranean stairwell, near the shelf where the Akula was parked. I am out. Going down. Good luck with class selection, Carl.
beats.gist: Katia Grim anchors to a temple wall while sharks slurp in timed charges and pain amplifier jellies.

beats.headline: The HAZMAT endorsement
beats.text: They brought me into the liaison's office first, because the Gate was in my inventory. They asked whether I considered myself its owner. I said Carl is its true owner, and then I was sent back to the staging area with a headache, and they kept the Gate. I think I accidentally got him into trouble. I didn't know what to say. The little room gave me three endorsements to choose from, ten minutes to choose, no chat. My class is still Monster Truck Driver. I took HAZMAT.
beats.gist: Katia Grim tells the liaison Carl owns the Gate, but they keep it and give her a headache.

beats.headline: Level fifty-two
beats.text: Carl finally notices my level. I was forty-four when I opened the Gate onto Larracos, and apparently it paid. Fifty-two. My base constitution is over a hundred now, which brought something called Steely Skin. The lower my health, the thicker my flesh. A Platinum Asshole's Box gave me a gambling chip and an upgrade to Find Crawler, and there's one more thing I almost tell him about and then don't. Louis and Firas have the Twister back from the changeling refugees. Meadow Lark, Bautista's team and others are gathering at a big settlement a few hours south, and Chris and I mean to reach them before the hunters are released.
beats.gist: Carl notices Katia is level fifty-two.

beats.headline: She won't be on there much longer
beats.text: The top ten hasn't changed since the end of the last floor. Donut thinks I should be back on it after what happened at the end of the last floor. I am perfectly content to hover outside the list. But Eva is ranked, ninth, and Donut says that isn't fair. Don't worry about that. She won't be on there for much longer. Carl looks at Mordecai. He opens his mouth to ask me something, and then shuts it again.
beats.gist: Donut says Eva's ninth rank is unfair, but Katia says Eva will not be there much longer.

beats.headline: A map the size of Iceland
beats.text: I made the map from the gate coordinates Gwen's team looted off Quetzalcoatlus. If I'm translating them correctly, it's about a hundred thousand square kilometres. Really similar to Iceland, even the shape. Four hundred-something kilometres north to south, three hundred-something east to west, and a river about five hundred long because it isn't straight. Imani mostly coordinates the reports as people call things in; I copy everything down. Some of the bridges are estimates. Carl wants one thing organised. I'll do anything he asks. To a point. He wants all the bridges knocked down except one.
beats.gist: Katia Grim makes a map the size of Iceland using coordinates looted off Quetzalcoatlus.

beats.headline: Big personalities
beats.text: We're okay. There are some big personalities in this group, and they don't all get along. Florin is doing a good Carl impersonation with how broody he's being. Gwen constantly wants to murder Louis and Firas. Britney has given up on everything, and I don't know what to do with her. We'll make it work. Southwest tomorrow, away from elf territory and deeper into the wild, grinding quests and collecting the former Daughters. Then the notifications arrive. Point Mongo? Really? And why did I just get a quest to hunt dinosaurs?
beats.gist: Katia Grim leads a group of conflicting personalities toward the southwest to collect former Daughters.

beats.headline: Leaving the party
beats.text: I watch the recap in the guild and come over to make the exchange and finally leave the party. Every time Donut gets a quest, I get one too, and soon I will be getting my own. We pooled enough for the purchase that lets Mordecai keep his space, and Mistress Tiatha gets her own as well; she is pretty excited. We would like Donut to be the one who buys it, because she has the highest charisma of any of us. She asks whether she can still visit. Of course. I will be right next door.
beats.gist: Katia Grim leaves the party after an exchange in the guild.

beats.headline: A decoy from a beanie
beats.text: We were trying to get back to Carl, but it was too far, so I am in a guildhall when he asks. I can't make a good facsimile of Donut in time. Daniel has a stuffed animal called a back alley mouser that will work, and I am at a table shaping a fake crown and sunglasses for it. It is a pity we don't have Robot Donut anymore.
beats.gist: Katia Grim shapes a fake crown and sunglasses for Daniel's stuffed back alley mouser.

beats.headline: Letting Louis build his confidence
beats.text: Carl tells me not to let Louis drop a giant breastplate on me. The idea has some merit, and I am trying to let him build his confidence. He doesn't show it, but he was really upset when he learned those elves were hunting him. I walked in on him earlier, when he thought he was alone, and he was crying. I think he is worried we will kick him out of the guild. Then I sew Carl's new patches on, and Donut tells me my stitches are off.
beats.gist: Katia Grim tries to let Louis build his confidence after he cried about hunting elves.

beats.headline: Doing the math on the creepers
beats.text: Carl gives me the rundown on Miriam. I have been doing the math from what he told me earlier, and some of these glamoured creepers were as high as level 150, maybe more, before they turned into plants. We will have to attack in groups, from afar. Eva's group has one right in the middle of them. If it does not take them out, we move in. Donut tells me to stay away from Tserendolgor. Her name is Mongolian.
beats.gist: Carl tells Katia about Miriam; Katia calculates that some glamoured creepers were level 150 before turning.

beats.headline: All business, level 54
beats.text: I come through from the guildhall in my big form with blood down my chest. Gwen and the others have two creepers cornered in the bush elf village with Eva's crew, and it is probably too late for most of the people there. Li Jun had been turned into a vampire and told nobody but his sister and Zhang, and I am still angry with him for it. He was cured when Miriam died. Then Eva gets credit for a kill while we stand here, and I tell Louis to come on.
beats.gist: Katia Grim arrives from the guildhall in her big form with blood down her chest.

beats.headline: Not over chat
beats.text: Carl wants to jump down the stairs five days early, and I tell him it is a knee-jerk reaction he will regret. We brought the changelings and Bonnie here for this. Then, outside the group chat: please don't go down yet. I need to talk to him about something, and I have been putting it off. Not over chat. It is not about Eva. That slippery bitch got away again. It can wait until we are through whatever happens next.
beats.gist: Katia Grim tells Carl jumping down the stairs five days early is a knee-jerk reaction.

beats.headline: The brambles end at the castle
beats.text: Carl asks how far the changelings are from the brambles. Far. They will have a few days, but that is it, and the Sledge's spell on the last day will be too late. Someone has to reach them through a Desperado Club, fast. I have done the math: the brambles finish covering the map just as the timer runs out, and the last corner is the high elf castle. We start that way, mapping stairwells, and first we go and get Britney. She has not killed a thing all floor. Her blood bar was empty.
beats.gist: Carl asks Katia Grim about the changelings, and she says they must use a Desperado Club.

beats.headline: The hunters are being sponsored
beats.text: The hunters' levels are not going up, and their gear keeps getting better: pulse rifles, electric armor, an anti-air gun in most of the bigger groups. I am fairly sure they are being allowed sponsors now. That is probably what the recap woman meant a few days ago. If they are stuck here, it makes sense. Their families are pouring money into the show, and most of it is locked to the hunter who receives it.
beats.gist: Katia Grim notes hunters have better gear, including pulse rifles and electric armor, due to sponsors.

beats.headline: It has to be Vrah
beats.text: Samantha says Diwata gives birth to new creatures, and Carl and I work it out at the same moment. She did not attack him because she had five minutes to reach her daughter. And she probably does not want to be the one who kills Carl, either. It would make Vrah look weak. It has to be Vrah. So Vrah is about to be cured, and we should assume she is back in this. Then Tina breaks away and eats a sleeping mushroom guard.
beats.gist: Samantha says Diwata gives birth to new creatures, and Carl and Katia determine Vrah must be cured.

beats.headline: I Need My Personal Space
beats.text: The only Apothecary box this floor not meant for Donut came to me. A small knit beanie: three per cent to all my stats, and a spell called I Need My Personal Space, which knocks everybody around me back with a powerful blow, including my own party. Good, and dangerous. I put it on, and it sinks into my mass. Carl pings me about the talk we still have not had. We should wait and see whether we can take the castle first.
beats.gist: Katia Grim gets an Apothecary box and a knit beanie that sinks into her mass.

beats.headline: She goes for Eva
beats.text: Eva is leaning on a table with over fifty player killer skulls above her. She stole all the potions in the dressing room and let me know it. Florin and Daniel are holding me back. I ask her why she's like this; these are her people too. The moment the protection is off, I'll rip her face off. She tells me, bored, that this is why Fannar couldn't stand me. What kind of mother could I have been. Carl tells me to be calm. I'm fine.
beats.gist: Katia Grim attacks Eva, who stole dressing room potions and leans under fifty player killer skulls.

beats.headline: Size-Up on the cat
beats.text: The Size-Up potion takes just over thirty seconds to seep in, and then I have him. Level 100, province boss, listed as a minion. A hundred down the line, dexterity 125, charisma 75, so constitution plus charisma is 175, and Donut clears it. The hat is magical, a level-10 lightning spell. He can go invisible and phase jump, and his claw attack looks brutal. When the hunters start closing in around Lucia, Carl tells us to watch out. We're on it. Don't micromanage, Carl.
beats.gist: Katia uses a Size-Up potion on a level 100 province boss listed as a minion.

beats.headline: She gives Carl her hat
beats.text: Daniel and Tran are getting hammered in the fight against Imogen, and I need to go back to them. Carl has used his protective shell already, and there's a mountain of bugs between him and the god. So I pull the beanie off my head, the one the Apothecary just gave me in a benefactor box, and put it on his. Use the spell to clear through the nymphs, I tell him. Get Donut close enough.
beats.gist: Katia Grim puts her benefactor box beanie on Carl so he can clear nymphs with a spell.

beats.headline: A second golden skull
beats.text: A champion has fallen. A bounty has been claimed. I walk past Carl with a second golden player killer skull over my head, and I tell him it's done, and go on to help the others. Li Na and her brother follow me. Then Carl is shouting my name, and I find the Popovs for him under the dead with Find Crawler. There are two of them. I can't believe I didn't see it.
beats.gist: Katia Grim walks past Carl with a second golden player killer skull and helps Li Na.

beats.headline: Eva's last act
beats.text: I find Eva with Find Crawler, alive under the bugs, and I make Daniel stay; I don't want him to see this. Li Na casts Preserve Injury. I cut off the hand with the escape ring, and the rapier. Eva wakes and asks me to heal her. Then she says she's sorry. That's all I wanted, to hear her afraid. I put the sword through her breastplate. As she dies she pulls something from the back of her armour: the Crown of the Sepsis Whore. It finds my head.
beats.gist: Katia finds Eva alive under bugs, makes Daniel stay, and kills Eva with a rapier.

beats.headline: Show me Annie
beats.text: I have two big secrets in this dungeon. One is the blitz sticks. I found them on Sally, one of Eva's victims; she worked at the airport, she was a healer, and the drugs were all that was left in her inventory. Eva left them there for me. A trap. I light one and think, show me Annie, and it does, every time: nine months old, standing in her crib, holding on to my hair. Mordecai warned me they're addictive. I didn't listen. Only Daniel knows.
beats.gist: Katia Grim uses addictive blitz sticks from a dead airport healer to see her daughter, Annie.

beats.headline: Worried about Britney
beats.text: We are in Iceland. Florin left the party just before the last level broke, and I have been asking where he is. My box gave me something that lets me move very fast. Louis and Britney have not opened theirs; they are still broken up about Firas. The burn on Britney's face still has not healed, and she has not stopped crying. She sits there, holding onto Louis. I have already asked Imani to come over. We will see if it helps.
beats.gist: Katia Grim asks Imani to come over because Britney cries and holds onto Louis in Iceland.

beats.headline: A pink Nykur
beats.text: The moment we walk out of the saferoom in Iceland, I see a Nykur. It is a type of horse, and it is supposed to be gray; this one is pink for no apparent reason. It is splattered by a car, and now there is a growing pile of crashes, which the ice does not help. The cars are already blocking the front entrance to our safe area, and Louis and Britney are trapped inside. We are closing off the area around it so it does not get worse, and then we have to clear it away.
beats.gist: Katia sees a pink Nykur splattered by a car outside the Iceland saferoom.

beats.headline: Checking on Carl
beats.text: Bautista, Louis and I come through to Carl's space. Imani and Tserendolgor are talking about her party joining the guild, and Imani thinks we should vote before we let other teams in. Then the real reason: Donut has been talking, but Carl has been antisocial, only business. He says he is doing okay. Living the dream. I am taking it one day at a time. The little trolls here, the Lads, drop a lot of cards, and Louis killed about two hundred with a cloud attack, so I give Carl two Flee cards and let him pick some utilities.
beats.gist: Bautista, Louis and Katia Grim visit Carl while Imani and Tserendolgor discuss guild voting.

beats.headline: A message only Carl gets
beats.text: I send it to Carl alone, not Donut. He answers that it's bad timing. I don't know where he is or what is happening, only what should be near him: a broken shrine of Yemaya, blue. If he can fix only one, it has to be that one. It will help save both me and Donut. He asks save us from what. So I say it plainly. I have the Crown of the Sepsis Whore on my head. There is a way out, and it has a lot of steps, and the first is resurrecting Yemaya. They engineered it this way. I would have told him sooner.
beats.gist: Katia Grim tells Carl to resurrect a blue broken shrine of Yemaya to save her.

beats.headline: The crown, shown to Donut
beats.text: I let the crown form on my head so Donut can see it. Eva did it at the last minute, right before she died, and it's my fault: I talked when I should have just killed her. Donut reminds me we don't monologue. I know. She says they want us to fight, like Ferdinand, like Odette bringing Miss Beatrice onto the show. I kiss her forehead. She's right. That's exactly what they want. It's what Eva wanted too. I tell her I love her, and that I will never fight her. I will die before I let that happen. Then I put the box on the table.
beats.gist: Katia Grim shows Donut the crown on her head and tells her she will never fight.

beats.headline: Choosing the attendant boon
beats.text: Two of the box's three seals are already broken: killing Eva, my old party member, and killing Imogen, a level boss. Worship came in an emergency sponsor box from Princess Formidable of the Skull Empire, a scroll I read at once. The full boon descriptions opened, and then Huanxin Jinx messaged me. Get Carl to repair the shrine and she would see I got a boon that lets both Donut and me survive. I don't want the pregnancy boon anymore. The surface, with a baby. I'll take Celestial Attendant. Mordecai calls the twelfth floor a viper den. She has promised to protect me.
beats.gist: Katia Grim chooses the Celestial Attendant boon after Huanxin Jinx messages her.

beats.headline: How to kill a sprite
beats.text: The table is full of friends, so Carl and I plan in chat. They can't know the target. Today is only a look. Astrid comes out of the back when there's trouble; Carl has drawn her out twice. She's level 125, she can boil his blood with a snap, she runs security and she's never alone. My part is how we kill her, and my plan uses my card deck. It's messy. His part is where. He has a place in mind, off the hall to the bathrooms and the guilds. Carl says they're going for Samantha first and will be back this way in a few days. We do it then.
beats.gist: Carl and Katia plan to kill Astrid using a card deck near the bathrooms and guilds.

beats.headline: A bucket, and it has to be now
beats.text: I am in my own face, at the table, and I cannot stop saying sorry. It was so real, Carl. It was like I was there, so much better than the blitz sticks. Then I am sick into Louis's bucket again. Imani has given me the first cure. Carl says we have three hours, that he needs my drawing skills, and that it has to be now. Daniel pushes me back into the chair. I tell him never to touch me like that. Then I stand up next to Carl and say I'm okay.
beats.gist: Katia Grim is sick into Louis's bucket and receives the first cure from Imani.

beats.headline: Do you feel guilty
beats.text: Drugged to the gills on Imani's buffs, I ask Carl whether he feels guilty about killing her. He says we are doing what we have to, that we did not ask for any of this. I tell him that sometimes I think about the futility of it. I have never wanted anyone hurt. The only time I did, it was Eva. And look what happened. He tells me not to let them break me. He is the master of cheeseball motivational speeches. I needed it.
beats.gist: Drugged on Imani's buffs, Katia asks Carl if he feels guilty about killing her.

beats.headline: A spike a hair from her head
beats.text: Carl says abort. I tell him no, this is my fault and I am fixing it, and that if he is not giving up on me I am not giving up on him and Donut. I play my deck in the kitchen: a hooded troll, then the crow with the child's skull. Astrid boils the troll's blood and turns to face it with Carl behind her. I come in invisible, get her in one of my shoulder hands, and drive a spike at her head, and then I cannot move. It stops a hair from her skull.
beats.gist: Katia Grim plays a hooded troll and a crow with a child's skull in the kitchen.

beats.headline: Hekla and Eva on the flag
beats.text: The first time Carl sees my squad flag is over the troll's head in the club kitchen. It is Hekla's face and Eva's face side by side, each with an X over the eyes, and the player-killer skull between them on the red. When Astrid is blind on the floor, begging someone to save her children, a spike comes out of my neck and goes through her head. I keep her on it.
beats.gist: Carl sees Katia Grim's squad flag over a troll's head in the club kitchen.

beats.headline: The orchid, not yet
beats.text: We did it. The quest is done, the box has opened, and the orchid is in my inventory. Huanxin writes to tell me there is one more thing Carl has to do, and then we will be safe. He says it happens in a few hours. When he asks when I will eat it, I tell him not until we are down on the ninth floor. I cannot abandon my squad.
beats.gist: Katia Grim finishes the quest, opens the box, and puts the orchid in her inventory.

beats.headline: Da Nang
beats.text: Carl says we need to talk. I cannot right now: they gave me one choice in the selection, Ukraine, and when I arrived it was Vietnam. He tells me to message him when I am safe. When Imani has everyone check in, it is both: my region is a mix of the two, and the Vietnam part is a city called Da Nang. It is where Tran is from. The key location is an apartment building, and both his ex-wife and his estranged mother live in it. I warn the others, so that nobody walks into it unwarned.
beats.gist: Katia Grim tells Carl her region is a mix of Ukraine and Da Nang, Vietnam.

beats.headline: One card of hers in the deck
beats.text: Our hydra is on a rooftop, among the ghosts of Tran's family, and it is made from Louis's mother, Britney's mother and Bautista's family. Almost nothing of mine. One totem card: Four-Armed Eva. I do not let that one stay. Firas is in the deck too; he is never summoned, and the card alone puts Britney into hysterics. Carl warns me in time about the two we get to keep. I keep a Vietnamese rabbit and Tran's mother.
beats.gist: Katia keeps a Vietnamese rabbit and Tran's mother after Carl warns her about the two cards.

beats.headline: A death sentence either way
beats.text: I am shaking, and not only from fear. I still have not done the final rehab treatment, the one where I relive a memory, and Imani's spells and Mordecai's potions are holding me up. Carl asks how I feel. Mostly like an idiot. Daniel does not want me to use the orchid. Carl does not either; he is afraid it is a death sentence. It is a death sentence if I do not use it. We jumped through a lot of hoops to get it, and it is the only way out I can see. I nearly tell him something, and do not.
beats.gist: Katia Grim shakes from fear and lacks a final rehab treatment.

beats.headline: Out of cards, and going for the goddess
beats.text: The goddess summons a strange version of Paz, and I put him in a shield jail, where he will probably time out. Then Annie is down, and I am out of cards. I cannot hurt Ysalte. Nobody can, on this floor. The quest does not require it. It only requires that she be kept busy until the timer runs out and the demon is cast free of her. So I tell Daniel to come to me. I am going to try to stop the goddess.
beats.gist: Katia puts a strange version of Paz in a shield jail to stop the goddess.

beats.headline: A bolt, reusable
beats.text: Carl says I should have had the credit for the goddess, since it was my Bolt of Ophiotaurus Paz drove into her eye. I am glad I did not get it. Every god is angry with him now. And magical bolts, as long as they do not break, can be used again; I show him. Princess Formidable gave it to me on the fourth floor to use on her brother, and that is still on the table. I did not get to loot the goddess. Her equipment went to Paz. I grew my arm back. It was nothing.
beats.gist: Katia Grim shows Carl a reusable Bolt of Ophiotaurus.

beats.headline: Carrying Tran, chasing a head
beats.text: We're at the college in Larracos, filling out visitor passes and dealing with guards who are sluggish under a Despondent debuff, trying to reach a saferoom. Tran's wheelchair is gone, so we carry him, and it slows everything down. Then Samantha rolls past, screaming that she's going to kill a woman named Tish, and I go after her before the guards react. She's rolling, not floating, and she's fast. I get her trapped in a corner. She's really mad. I bring her back through the safe room.
beats.gist: Katia Grim carries Tran through a college in Larracos to reach a saferoom.

beats.headline: Eyebrows, eyelashes, and a failed spell
beats.text: Carl waited for me to do his hair tonic. Eyebrows first, then eyelashes, which is almost the pubic hair recipe, so I'm careful. He asks, quietly, if I'm okay. I'm hanging in there. Mordecai is brewing something that might help with the rehab, and I'll take it tomorrow, before the ceasefire ends. The head mix can only sit for five seconds, so I have an otter water mage, one of the strippers, ready to power-wash it off. As a mercenary, his spell won't cast in the saferoom. Carl's hair now reaches his waist.
beats.gist: Katia Grim applies hair tonic to Carl's eyebrows and eyelashes until his hair reaches his waist.

beats.headline: Twice to Glory Bound
beats.text: Mordecai's jar is two hits of Glory Bound in a gel, cut with a potion called Tough Love. Eight to ten hours, for me. Once I am under I am on my own, and Edgar says waking me early could be fatal. That's a cheerful thought. I drink the sleeping potion. Skál. Then I tell Carl a secret. My favourite memory and my worst memory are the same thing, and I am going back to where I went last time. He tells me to take his hand. I do, and Imani pulls us apart.
beats.gist: Katia Grim drinks a sleeping potion and tells Carl a secret before Imani pulls them apart.

beats.headline: We left her with Annie
beats.text: They tell me Carl vanished off his cot as it began, stayed translucent, then went completely. The Lemig team knew the moment he went under and tried something through the warlord chat. I message him. He is in the high elf castle. And we left her there, Carl. We left Shi Maria alone in that room with Annie. He says it was only a memory, and asks if it worked. It is not a switch one flips. We will not know right away. But yes. I think it worked.
beats.gist: Katia Grim learns Carl vanished from his cot and is in the high elf castle.

beats.headline: A chain shaped like a dragon
beats.text: The ink is mixed from Li Na's blood, given freely, and that means Carl gets to choose the skill. She's not mad at him; she's mad at herself for not protecting her brother. She lost five levels of it for now, and she can still use it. It's a level-thirteen skill, so the tattoo has to be large and uses nearly all the vial. I have never done a real tattoo. Samantha's neck doesn't count. Donut wants the design drawn in the voodoo book first for her approval. Carl wants a chain shaped like a dragon.
beats.gist: Carl uses a vial of Li Na's freely given blood to tattoo a dragon-shaped chain on Katia.

beats.headline: The flower, if it comes to that
beats.text: Daniel and I argue in chat, and I say no out loud. He wants me to eat the flower now. He's afraid that if this goes badly, Carl will turn on me to get it for Donut. I tell Carl so, and he says he would never. I know. Then I tell him something I haven't told Daniel: if it comes to that, I will give him the flower. Huanxin Jinx will rage, but I'm certain she'll take Donut to the twelfth floor. Donut wouldn't allow it, he says. I know. That's why I'm telling you and not her.
beats.gist: Katia tells Carl she will give him the flower if it comes to that.

beats.headline: Temple defense protocols
beats.text: I come through the door as one of the club's four-armed guards, soaked in the cherries and sausage sandwich Carl's broken food box made when he asked it for cobbler. Demons attack the temple behind me, I shout. We must initiate temple defense protocols. That's what Tipid said the procedure is called. The one with his claws stuck in the ceiling asks, temple defense protocols? Fight to the death, I say. Kill all the heathens. Uh, steel and heavy metal. What manner of demon is it? Two of Daniel's stuffed pyxies fly over my shoulders and come alive. That kind.
beats.gist: Katia Grim enters as a four-armed guard soaked in cherries and sausage sandwich.

beats.headline: God or not, I'm staying
beats.text: Carl tells us to run the moment we unfreeze, reset the door, hide in our own temples if we have to; he'll cover us. Prepotente says he did not come this far to run. Me neither, Carl. God or not, I'm staying. Donut is shouting in capitals that there aren't supposed to be gods yet. Then, under a thirty-second timer, Carl sends his plan. No. No way, Carl. That's insane, even for you. Prepotente says he would actually be quite curious to see if it works.
beats.gist: Carl tells Katia Grim and Prepotente to run and hide; Katia Grim refuses to leave.

beats.headline: Knee pads of the goddess Kina
beats.text: In the interview bubble, Drick says my celestial knee pads are a waste on someone planning to leave the dungeon; they were awarded in hopes I'd hand them to Carl, and they even look like his. They are made of the eyelashes of the sea goddess Kina: damage reflect, breathing underwater, Swim, Iron Stomach and Eater of the Dead. Kevin asks if I'm wearing them. I'm not. I tell him I left them at the guild. Before I took them off, I gained twenty points of intelligence eating throwaway magic items, until it became too much.
beats.gist: Katia Grim has celestial knee pads made of the eyelashes of the sea goddess Kina.

beats.headline: Plan B
beats.text: Subterfuge is gone. The rainbow has pulled half the Madness out to meet us, and the other half is already facing the 103rd. Prepotente can shield one group from their psionics, not both. Carl hesitates. So I say it: we still have Donut to cover the 103rd as they retreat. Bring Prepotente here, and use Donut to the best of her ability. He tells me I'm right. Then the missiles land on their castle, and in the light I can see the dune buggies coming at us.
beats.gist: Katia tells Carl to use Donut to cover the 103rd while Prepotente shields them.

beats.headline: Annie, in the dream
beats.text: Days ago, in the dream potion, Carl lands in my dream instead of his own, our hands fused together. A children's hospital in Iceland. Fannar, my ex, arrives to tell them the truth, and the woman denies my adoption, and I scream into my fist in a bathroom stall. Then I go to Annie. Brain cancer. She died alone. Nobody told me, until I met a nurse in a park who said she passed a few weeks ago, as if it did not matter. It is my worst memory and my favourite. I love Daniel. I tell Carl I love him and Donut more.
beats.gist: Carl lands in Katia Grim's dream potion; their hands fuse in a children's hospital in Iceland.

beats.headline: Especially after today
beats.text: Carl asks what Louis meant about a cop's husband. It's for Louis to tell, but when he was young a police officer was shot dead protecting him, and at her funeral her husband said something very cruel to him that has stuck. Donut shouts that sad stories will jinx the rescue. Then, privately, Carl asks what Carl it up means. I don't know. I'm willing to bet we'll find out, now that she's told him. He asks if I'm sure this is what I want. Yes, Carl. Especially after all we learned today.
beats.gist: Carl asks Katia about a cop's husband, and she tells him about a cruel man.

beats.headline: I love all of you
beats.text: Carl shouts at me to eat the orchid. Now. It takes sixty minutes and we have sixty-five. I haven't transferred all my inventory away; there's stuff in the safe room I need. He puts his forehead against mine. This isn't goodbye, this is how we win, and it's my plan. I've already given Donut the things. I remind him I said he'd Carl it up. He says this one's on Samantha. I love you. I love all of you. I climb onto the table where Kiwi gave birth, and I eat it.
beats.gist: Carl tells Katia Grim to eat the orchid on the table where Kiwi gave birth.

beats.headline: The only way to reach them
beats.text: I choose to be made pregnant. The goddess asks if I'm certain and offers me a place in her court, kept safe. I tell her the rules here are strange. If I'm pregnant, I get sent somewhere else, and there are children up there, mostly alone, in trouble. This is the only way I can get to them. She says she senses them and cannot reach them. I am made human again, and my friends see what I've lost: an arm, a leg, the other below the knee, an ear. We've all become experts at hiding what we've really lost.
beats.gist: Katia Grim chooses to be made pregnant to reach children who are alone and in trouble.

beats.headline: She takes the Orchid and goes
beats.text: Crawler Katia Grim has left the dungeon. Not by the stairs. She ate the Orchid of Eileithyia's Grace and lay for an hour at one percent, and when she opened her eyes the goddess was standing over her, telling her to get up. She got up. Where she has gone is between her and the goddess.
beats.gist: Katia Grim eats the Orchid of Eileithyia's Grace and leaves the dungeon.

relations.note: Her spare card, given to Donut
Her boon, and the door out
